lines.beat: Naude enters trying to take over. Lance doesn't even look at her.
lines.cue: NAUDE: "Lance, the captain's called me in to take over—"
lines.line: --Fuck Off.
lines.hook: He doesn't even finish her sentence. Cuts her cold. TWO WORDS.
lines.emotion: Cold rage. Don't shout — it's scarier quiet.

lines.beat: Naude asks for his service pistol. He hands it over without looking.
lines.cue: NAUDE: "Ok, but give it to me Lance. I know you're not careless enough..."
lines.line: Don't need it.
lines.hook: Three words. He means it literally — he plans to use his hands.
lines.emotion: Flat. Chilling. No inflection.

lines.beat: Naude makes one last plea before leaving.
lines.cue: NAUDE: "Lance... please—"
lines.line: Fuck. Off.
lines.hook: Same two words as before, but with a full stop between them. Heavier. Deliberate.
lines.emotion: Barely contained. Each word is a warning.

lines.beat: Lance starts the voice recorder. Procedural — recite it like a man who's done it a thousand times but is barely holding together.
lines.cue: [Lance starts recording — no cue from Oscar]
lines.line: The date is August 4th 2025, 01:13am. Detective Lance Mullen, 9013-BA, Capricorn Unit. Suspect in custody is Oscar Phiri 8806215286082. Apprehended at 23:13pm, August 3rd at the scene in question. Processed at Douglasdale Police Station by Lieutenant Mavimbela. Observer and Reserve are Captain Phineas Tsotetsi and Inspector Beverly Naude. Respectively.
lines.hook: Break it into chunks: DATE / NAME + BADGE / SUSPECT ID / ARREST DETAILS / STATION / OBSERVERS. Each chunk like a robot trying not to cry.
lines.emotion: Robotic professionalism over boiling fury.

lines.beat: The interrogation begins. Lance opens with a direct question.
lines.cue: [Opens file. Picks up pen. Looks at Oscar.]
lines.line: What time did you arrive at 3 Fisant Avenue on the evening of the 3rd of August 2025 Mr. Phiri.
lines.hook: ADDRESS: 3 Fisant Avenue. DATE: evening of the 3rd. He says 'Mr. Phiri' — respect he doesn't feel, control he's forcing.
lines.emotion: Low, stern, professional. The volcano has a lid on it — for now.

lines.beat: Oscar mocks the 'Mr.' Lance swallows it and repeats himself.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Mr. even. Whew, that must be tough."
lines.line: Let me try again. What time did you arrive at 3 Fisant Avenue on the evening of the 3rd of August 2025?
lines.hook: 'Let me try again' — that phrase is the key. Same question, more menacing. No 'Mr. Phiri' this time.
lines.emotion: Menacing beneath the calm. Gritted teeth.

lines.beat: Oscar gets philosophical. Lance snaps him back to reality.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Oh but nothing is ever easy is it detective?"
lines.line: Mr. Phiri, it would benefit you greatly to answer my questions, as quickly and as honestly as possible. This doesn't have to take time, this doesn't have to be difficult.
lines.hook: 'Benefit you greatly' — lawyer-speak from a man who has no intention of helping Oscar. BENEFIT / QUICKLY & HONESTLY / DOESN'T HAVE TO BE.
lines.emotion: Controlled. Every word a threat wrapped in courtesy.

lines.beat: Oscar references the two-way glass and the people watching.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "In the movies, there are people watching behind that window... Is that the case here?"
lines.line: Let's say they are there? How long do you think it would take them to get in here and save you?
lines.hook: He turns Oscar's question back on him. A threat disguised as a hypothetical.
lines.emotion: Cold smile energy. He already knows what he plans to do.

lines.beat: Oscar asks if there's salvation for people like them.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Do you think there's salvation for people like us detective?"
lines.line: Not when I'm involved typically.
lines.hook: Five words. Short. Lethal. 'Typically' is the key word — makes it sound routine.
lines.emotion: Matter of fact. Almost bored with violence.

lines.beat: Lance breaks from procedure — the word 'kill' nearly destroys him mid-sentence.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "You don't strike me as someone who saves people."
lines.line:
What did you want there? And before you get smart with me again, I know it wasn't to steal anything. You didn't touch a single item in the house.

[beat — nearly breaks]

Who sent you to kill... to kill her?
lines.hook: The stutter on 'kill...to kill her' is in the script. It's real. Let it happen. WANT / DIDN'T STEAL / WHO SENT YOU.
lines.emotion: The crack in the wall. The first moment we see the man behind the detective.

lines.beat: Lance returns after crying. Speaks to someone at the door before entering.
lines.cue: [To unseen figure at the door]
lines.line: Yeah, I'm good. Let's get it over with. I can handle it.
lines.hook: He's lying to whoever is out there. Three short beats. He's lying to himself too.
lines.emotion: Fragile resolve. Eyes still swollen.

lines.beat: Lance restarts the recording and refocuses.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Do you ever get the sense you've seen someone or some place before detective?"
lines.line: I've asked you two questions, both of which I still want answers for.
lines.hook: He ignores Oscar's philosophy. Refuses to give him anything. Back to business.
lines.emotion: Deliberately flat. Refusing to give Oscar anything.

lines.beat: Oscar reveals he was sent specifically for Lance's wife. Lance can't process it.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "I was there to kill your wife detective."
lines.line: Who the fuck are you?
lines.hook: Shortest version of the question. Pure shock. No tactics left.
lines.emotion: Raw. Shaking. The detective disappears and the husband emerges.

lines.beat: Oscar stays silent. Lance loses it.
lines.cue: [Oscar stares — pity and resentment, says nothing]
lines.line: I said, who the fuck are you? Who sent you?
lines.hook: 'I SAID' — he's repeating himself. ADD 'Who sent you?' this time.
lines.emotion: Breathing heavy. Barely at the table.

lines.beat: Lance has nearly attacked Oscar. He pulls back and agrees to play Oscar's game.
lines.cue: NAUDE (V.O.): 'LANCE! recess!'
lines.line:
I'm good, I'm good. Please, don't take this away from me captain. I need answers.

[Retreats to chair. To Oscar:]

What is your question?
lines.hook: Two parts: PLEAD TO CAPTAIN / CONCEDE TO OSCAR. 'I need answers' — desperation.
lines.emotion: Desperation and self-loathing at having to beg.

lines.beat: Oscar asks where Lance was 3 years ago. Lance laughs — bitter, broken laughter.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "First question: Do you remember where you were on this exact day 3 years ago?"
lines.line: Is this a fucken joke to you? Who the fuck do you think you are interrogating me? Do you know what the hell is happening to you right now?
lines.hook: THREE questions back at him: JOKE? / WHO ARE YOU TO INTERROGATE? / DO YOU KNOW YOUR SITUATION? He laughs while he says it — manic.
lines.emotion: Bitter, manic laughter. Pain dressed as contempt.

lines.beat: Lance drops the laughing act. He needs to know.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "We are not so different me and you, right?"
lines.line: Who the fuck are you? How do you know me.
lines.hook: No question mark on 'How do you know me' — it's not really a question anymore. It's fear.
lines.emotion: Fear creeping in under the rage.

lines.beat: Lance draws the line between them. Tries to establish dominance.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "We're not getting anywhere, are we detective."
lines.line: You're nothing. Nothing at all. And if I do nothing to you right this minute. Believe me you won't last long in your cell. I'll make sure of that. I could kill you now and forget your face by the time the sun comes out. That's the difference. You're nothing, and you're nothing like me.
lines.hook: The word NOTHING appears 4 times. That's your anchor. NOTHING / NOTHING AT ALL / DO NOTHING / YOU'RE NOTHING / NOTHING LIKE ME.
lines.emotion: Cold fury. This is Lance trying to feel big. Oscar is about to make him feel small.

lines.beat: Oscar says 'Mandy died for nothing.' Lance explodes.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Mandy died for nothing."
lines.line: You piece of shit! Don't tell me my wife died for fucken nothing! I swear I'll end this myself! You think this is a fucken game!?
lines.hook: PIECE OF SHIT / DON'T TELL ME / I'LL END THIS / IS THIS A GAME. The rage is now grief. He just said her name — Mandy.
lines.emotion: Pure grief-rage. The dam breaks.

lines.beat: Lance calls Oscar worthless and gets cut off mid-sentence.
lines.cue: [Lance advancing on Oscar]
lines.line: Who the fuck sent you, you worthless piece of—
lines.hook: He gets cut off. The em-dash is literal. Oscar explodes and Lance stops cold.
lines.emotion: White-hot rage — then sudden fear when Oscar mirrors it back.

lines.beat: Oscar knows about Kevin. Lance panics and deflects.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "That's also the night your son died no?"
lines.line: What the fuck are you talking about laaitie. You have no idea what the hell you're saying.
lines.hook: 'laaitie' — Joburg slang slips out. He's rattled. WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT / YOU HAVE NO IDEA.
lines.emotion: Panic hidden under aggression. He glances at the window — has anyone heard?

lines.beat: Oscar implies he understands why Lance killed Kevin's dealer. Lance snaps and confesses — not realizing what he's doing.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Oh, so you can feel something. Is that why you did it? I would've done the same thing."
lines.line: Fucken right! I did fucken kill the asshole who gave my boy those drugs, and I'd do it a million times over. Just what do you think I'll do to the man who killed my wife too now, the only thing I had left in this world. Now I have nothing, and nothing to lose.
lines.hook: FUCKEN RIGHT / KILLED THE DEALER / DO IT AGAIN / WHAT ABOUT MY WIFE / NOTHING LEFT / NOTHING TO LOSE. This is a confession AND a threat.
lines.emotion: Explosive. Grief, pride, threat — all at once. He thinks he's winning. He isn't.

lines.beat: Oscar says 'You're free now, you're welcome.' Lance goes cold.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "You're free now, you're welcome. You're like me. Nothing."
lines.line: Say another word.
lines.hook: Three words. The quietest he's been since the confession. Deadly quiet.
lines.emotion: Ice cold. The realization is hitting. He knows what Oscar knows.

lines.beat: Oscar reveals he killed the man Lance framed — his own father. Lance crumbles.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Why did you choose my father? He was home, alone. Innocent."
lines.line: Shut up. Shut the fuck up!
lines.hook: Escalation: SHUT UP → SHUT THE FUCK UP. Same impulse, doubled.
lines.emotion: Desperate. He doesn't want this truth spoken aloud — especially not in front of the glass.

lines.beat: Oscar continues describing his innocent father waiting on the porch. Lance is breaking apart.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "He was never the type to bother anyone. He was waiting for me. Patiently."
lines.line: I said shut your fucken mouth!
lines.hook: 'I SAID' again — echoes line 14. He's losing control the same way each time.
lines.emotion: Desperation. He charges Oscar. Everything falls apart.
